```yaml
name: Docs Automation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_claude:
        description: "Whether to run Claude Code"
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
      create_pr:
        description: "Whether to create PR in docs-new"
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
      max_turns:
        description: "Max Claude turns (increase if hitting limit)"
        required: false
        default: 50
        type: number

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout instantsearch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Setup Melos
        uses: bluefireteam/melos-action@v3

      - name: Get latest release
        id: get_release
        run: |
          # Get the latest release tag
          LATEST_RELEASE=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "v0.0.0")
          echo "latest_release=$LATEST_RELEASE" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run Claude Code
        if: github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'true'
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        id: claude
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          prompt_file: .github/prompts/docs-sync.prompt
          max_turns: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_turns || 50 }}
          timeout_minutes: 15
          model: "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620"
          settings: |
            {
              "package_flavors": {
                "instantsearch.js": "javascript",
                "react-instantsearch": "react",
                "vue-instantsearch": "vue"
              }
            }

      - name: Prepare documentation changes
        id: prepare_changes
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ steps.claude.conclusion }}" == "success" ]]; then
            echo "changes_detected=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "changes_detected=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Create temporary directory
        run: mkdir -p /tmp/docs-sync

      - name: Copy documentation files
        if: env.changes_detected == 'true'
        run: |
          # Copy generated files to temp directory
          cp -r docs/* /tmp/docs-sync/ 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Create PR in docs-new
        if: github.event.inputs.create_pr == 'true' && env.changes_detected == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
          commit-message: "docs: update documentation for ${{ env.latest_release }}"
          title: "docs: update documentation for ${{ env.latest_release }}"
          body: |
            This PR was automatically generated by the docs automation workflow.
            
            Changes include updates to documentation for the ${{ env.latest_release }} release.
            
            Please review and merge after verification.
            
            Related to: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
          branch: docs-update-${{ env.latest_release }}
          delete-branch: true
          draft: true
          labels: |
            documentation
            automated-pr
          reviewers: |
            frontend-experiences-web

      - name: Dry run output
        if: github.event.inputs.run_claude != 'true' || github.event.inputs.create_pr != 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Dry run mode - No changes will be made"
          echo "Would process release: ${{ env.latest_release }}"
          echo "Claude Code would be executed: ${{ github.event.inputs.run_claude }}"
          echo "PR creation would be attempted: ${{ github.event.inputs.create_pr }}"
```
